_doc: hosted_server.js config. Flags/env (PORT, BIND, LOG_DIR, MIRROR, MODE) override port/bind/mode. rooms: listed in /list, each its own world (region+id; all use the Atlanta#4 tables). mode: single = v0.1 gameplay, one world per socket; multi = shared rooms (hosted/world.js) with the numbers in game (defaults in hosted/game_config.js, sources in game_sources). limits: robustness caps. world: world file (relative to mimic/; flag --world / env WORLD override), default world_sp5.json (per-phase layouts; world_atl4.json = one snow layout as phase 1).
